Would love to get you a short 30-minute demo so our AE can walk through a focused run-through of request/throughput patterns and deployment options for Finstack. Proposing a few slots (PT):

- We care most about embedding throughput and inference latency under burst.
- Security/compliance is a must — Samir will want to review how data is isolated for private deployments.

We can do Wed Jun 9 at 5:00pm ET and I’ve set this to 45 minutes as requested. Draft agenda below; please let me know if you want anything changed:
- 5 min intros & success metrics
- 10 min high-level architecture and deployment modes (Hosted / Dedicated / Private)
- 15 min demo focused on embedding throughput, batching, and cache behavior under burst
- 10 min security/compliance overview (data isolation, KMS/HSM integrations, audit logs)
- 5 min next steps / pricing ballpark / follow-ups

Prep ask: if you can share a rough payload size and expected QPS (or a sample synthetic payload) that would help tailor the demo. If not, no problem — we’ll use a representative synthetic workload.

I’ve attached a calendar invite (redwood-demo-20270609.ics) and a short pre-demo checklist for the call.

Agenda link: https://drive.redwood.ai/summit-demo-agenda/DL-2027-0987
